text: Sinobo Group Co., Ltd. (中赫集团有限公司), founded in September 2005 with a business scope covering mining and real-estate investment and asset management, has Zhou Jinhui (周金辉) as its legal representative and is jointly held by Zhou Jinhui and Li Caixia (李彩霞), per company registration data.
short: Sinobo Group (中赫集团) is held jointly by Zhou Jinhui and Li Caixia.

source.name: Sohu (ITBEAR): 中赫集团、国安俱乐部及周金辉等被恢复执行36.8亿
source.quote: 中赫集团有限公司成立于2005年9月，法定代表人为周金辉，注册资本1.17亿人民币，经营范围含矿业投资、房地产投资、资产管理、矿业投资管理、房地产投资管理、体育运动项目经营等，由周金辉、李彩霞共同持股。
source.note: Translation: 'Sinobo Group Co., Ltd. was founded in September 2005, legal representative Zhou Jinhui, registered capital RMB 117 million, with a business scope including mining investment, real-estate investment and asset management; it is jointly held by Zhou Jinhui and Li Caixia.' The article attributes the company details to Tianyancha (天眼查) registration data.
